one_line: This is a preliminary permanent restroom conversion project, outside our documented rental scope, with no actual solicitation or response instructions supplied.
scope: Darien is considering converting part of the Pear Tree concession area into one or more completely ADA accessible, family accessible restrooms using existing infrastructure. The project could eliminate the year-round portable toilet; funding and timing remain preliminary.
fit: Connecticut falls within our stated nationwide service area.
Our restroom trailers and sanitation services could support a separately requested temporary-facility need.
SBE/MBE status presents no stated set-aside conflict; none is identified.
red_flags: The notice is classified as Agendas / Minutes, supported by unofficial YouTube captions, rather than an IFB, RFP, sources sought, or RFI.
Permanent building conversion is outside our documented core rental competencies and past performance.
Listed NAICS 236220 is absent from our supplied NAICS coverage. No PSC is stated, and our supplied GSA SINs do not establish coverage for this conversion.
The project could be deferred because of department workload.
Staff described a substantial-improvement spending limit of 50% of building value over three years; the $75,000 allowance leaves room below an approximately $100,000 limit.
competition: No incumbent, past winner, or offer count is supplied for this conversion. The bid pack found no agency awards under NAICS 236220 and no matching award benchmarks; proposal counts for unrelated projects do not establish competition here.
price_signal: $75,000 is a preliminary budget allowance, not an award price or firm estimate. No comparable construction awards are supplied; our rental price list and temporary-facility awards do not establish a conversion price.
must_have: The proposed facilities must be completely ADA accessible and family accessible; detailed specifications are not supplied. Source: meeting transcript, 00:44:29–00:45:32.
